description: This file defines the GatewayHealthMonitor class, which performs periodic health checks on a gateway, handling configuration, scheduling, timeouts, and failure management.

classes.name: GatewayHealthMonitor
classes.description: A final class responsible for health monitoring of a gateway, capable of periodically checking health status and handling failures.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the health monitoring task with provided check and failure handling closures.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing health monitoring task.

methods.name: runCheck
methods.description: Performs a health check with an optional timeout, returning boolean status.
